reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random: "Thanks, Ilse, got it. I've noted 100 seats for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal. I won't do anything else with it."

She asked for no action, so I didn't change anything else. I didn't repeat or correct her #north-team post. I also left #north-team out of the reply, because some people in #north-random may not be able to see that channel. A seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, and she posted it here herself, so it was fine to repeat in this channel.
